text.title: ui-ux-design.md Template Decision Tree
text.summary: Rendered-output gate first, then existence and shape checks on the artefact. Routes to produce / a specific rule / explicit skip; every conclusion references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the feature render or modify any visible element — web (page, component, form, button, modal, navigation), mobile (screen, sheet, gesture handler) or CLI TUI (prompt, picker, dashboard view)?

branch.conclusion: Skip the artefact — backend-only, API-only, data migration, internal refactor, or build/CI/infra. Mark readiness.md item 7 "no UI impact" with a one-line reason.
Produce it from templates/ui-ux-design.md.tmpl — the artefact is the only forcing function.

branch.question: Does the artefact pass the shape checks?

branch.conclusion: Exactly five rows: N1, N3, N4, N5, N6. Remove N2/N7–N10 rows or add the missing ones.
Name empty, loading, error, success and disabled before code lands.
Restore the order Intent, Layout, States, Nielsen audit, Norman audit, Copy & microcopy; fill empty sections with "n/a" and a reason.
Add a loading indicator, button press state or focus change within 100ms.
The artefact passes; the reviewer ticks readiness.md item 7 with it as evidence.
Outside the SDD feature lifecycle; nothing to gate.

text.example: inputs: {surface=web form, in_progress=true, ui-ux-design.md exists, states rows: success only, nielsen rows: N1,N3,N4,N5,N6} q-rendered -> true q-exists -> true q-shape -> states_rows < 5 => conclusion states-table-all-five: fill empty / loading / error / disabled, then re-run; all_shape_checks_pass -> run-the-checklist.
